standard.summary: 可添加多组预览，并为每组单独设置 seed、LoRA
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: You can add several preview groups and set the seed and LoRA separately for each
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 可添加多组预览，并为每组单独设置 seed、LoRA 权重和延迟启用轮次；例如第三组从第 3 个 epoch 后再开始测试泛化性。留空时仍使用上方旧提示词。

advanced_en.principle: Multiple preview groups can be added, each with its own seed, LoRA weight, and deferred-enable epoch; e.g. a third group starts testing generalization only after epoch 3. When empty, the legacy prompts above are still used.
